text:
brightco-billing: Hi team — autopay for invoice INV-8821 failed for our customer on 2026-02-28. Two attempts: the dashboard shows first decline 'insufficient_funds', second attempt triggered 3DS but ended with 'ACS_TIMEOUT'. Customer says they completed the challenge. Can you help repro and advise? payment_intent: pi_3Lq2XabcDEFg - attaching what we have. :thinking_face:

anna (support): Sorry about that — can you share the exact timestamps and any gateway response IDs? We'll pull the gateway and Redwood logs.

brightco-billing: Timestamps are 2026-02-28T15:42:06Z and 2026-02-28T15:44:11Z. gateway_response_id gtw_9f7a, acquirer_trace_id acq_334455, card last4 4242, issuer country GB. Frontend console shows iframe reload + `POST /3ds/callback 502`.

samir (payments-eng): Looking. Quick hypothesis: ACS returned a challenge but the ACS callback timed out/backed by a 502 from the acquirer stack. Can you paste the raw gateway response blob if available (JSON)? Also confirm merchant used redirect flow vs embedded iframe.

brightco-billing: We use redirect mode for BrightCo. Raw snippet from their logs: ```gateway: {"status":"challenge","acs":"https://acs.bank/3ds","result":"timeout","issuer_msg":"timeout waiting for ACS","gateway_id":"gtw_9f7a"}``` Frontend also logged `Error: iframe load failed, status 502`.

samir (payments-eng): Thanks. Two parallel things to check: 1) acquirer response code mapping — sometimes gateways return generic `insufficient_funds` when an auth path fails mid-flow. Need raw acquirer_code (we have 91 in your header) and the full gateway event. 2) fraud signals — if our fraud engine flagged velocity/avs mismatch we may auto-decline or instruct gateway to fallback. Any fraud webhook IDs?

leo (ops): Pulling network traces for the acs.bank host (IP seen 3.4.5.6). Noting intermittent 502s from our egress to that host in the last 3 hours. @samir could WAF/egress rules be rejecting long POSTs from ACS callback?

samir (payments-eng): Possible. Also check that our timeout for ACS callbacks (currently 12s) wasn't hit; if ACS takes longer, gateway may report `ACS_TIMEOUT`. Also check fraud: this payment had fraud_score=72 and rule=velocity-7, AVS mismatch flagged. If fraud blocked capture, gateway sometimes surfaces 'insufficient_funds' upstream. We need the acquirer_reason_code — can you paste it from the raw event?

brightco-billing: acquirer_reason_code: 61 (present in gateway event), gateway_event: gtw_9f7a. We ran a local repro and got same 502 in the callback step. Customer says they clicked approve at 15:44:07 but ACS callback never completed.

anna (support): BrightCo — actionable next steps from Redwood: 1) please try a manual one-time charge (non-autopay) to see if redirect flow completes; 2) if customer can reproduce, please record a screen capture/screenshot of the ACS challenge and exact timestamp; 3) we'll escalate to gateway ops with gtw_9f7a + acq_334455. In parallel we'll run a replay in staging against that gateway id.

brightco-billing: Ok will try manual charge and push screenshot. Quick repro curl we used for confirm: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/payments/confirm -H "Authorization: Bearer rwd_live_xxx" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"payment_intent":"pi_3Lq2XabcDEFg","return_url":"https://brightco.co/3ds-callback"}'``` They used redirect mode and our return handler returned 502 once ACS posted back.

samir (payments-eng): I've queued a staged replay against gtw_9f7a to simulate the ACS flow and our callback handling. If we reproduce the 502, mitigation options: - route autopay vault charges via PSD2-exempt/no-challenge path (if acquirer supports) - enable automatic retry after short backoff (3m) - allow merchant-level `skip_3ds_for_vaulted` flag (requires legal/ops signoff for PSD2). Also checking whether our egress WAF dropped ACS payloads.

anna (support): Marking P1 and creating escalation ticket SUP-8421. Escalating to gateway-ops and legal for PSD2/skip_3ds discussion. Will include all logs and your replay notes. :thumbsup:

payments-bot: escalated SUP-8421 -> gateway-ops, assigned to cindy.ops, priority P1, ETA 4h.

brightco-billing: Thanks — customer needs invoice processed by 2026-03-01. Is there a recommended manual workaround?

anna (support): Short term workaround: ask customer to complete a one-time payment via the hosted payment link with a different funding source (or use card entry rather than autopay). We'll follow up once gateway ops returns.

samir (payments-eng): Added note: if you can reproduce in staging, include full HAR of the redirect + time-synced server logs. That will speed gateway ops investigation. I'll post any replay results here.

brightco-billing: Will send screenshots and HAR when done. Thanks everyone for the quick triage.
